verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own docs describe the Inso CLI as a tool for automating API test execution in Git workflows. They also say it is designed for CI: it disables prompts and returns exit codes that pass or fail the workflow, which covers running tests and failing the build. missing for 10: a documented command for running collections (the only explicit CI command shown is `inso lint spec`), detail on test reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI collection runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my API test collections in CI with a CLI and fail the build on regressions

citations.quote: Inso CLI is designed to run in a Continuous Integration (CI) environment. It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
Automate your tests with Inso CLI
Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.
